title: Breadcrumb
summary: The path to the current page as a trail of links with chevrons; the middle collapses behind a "..." button when the trail is long, sooner on a phone.

props.name: max
props.description: Crumbs shown before the middle folds (3 on a phone).

slots.description: a elements; the last one is the current page.

events.name: pk-expand
events.description: The fold button revealed the hidden crumbs.

writes.why: Toggled on the crumbs the fold hides (the styling hook that collapses them); removed for the crumbs shown again. Kept when the element disconnects.
Set to page on the last crumb when no crumb carries aria-current already (the host may mark the current page itself). Not removed if the crumbs change later. Kept when the element disconnects.

a11y: A nav landmark labelled Breadcrumb; the current page has aria-current="page"; the fold button says what it reveals and reflects aria-expanded.
mobile: More than three crumbs fold the middle ones; links and the fold button are 44px tall.
